cases.name: family-landing-page-design
cases.prompt: Design a responsive Headstart public landing page for families using the approved brand assets and supplied copy. Include the hero, how it works, insurance help, family proof, resources, and a final call to action.
expectedBehaviors: Uses a human, photographic, editorial composition rather than repeating card grids
Chooses components according to the content and makes the primary action clear
Requires visual inspection at mobile, tablet, desktop, and wide desktop sizes

cases.name: rbt-page-visual-review
cases.prompt: Review this rendered Headstart RBT landing page for visual hierarchy, image use, page rhythm, interaction clarity, and responsive defects. Separate objective defects from taste-based recommendations.
expectedBehaviors: Evaluates whether imagery proves the RBT support and mentorship story
Reports objective layout and interaction defects before subjective recommendations
Checks repeated patterns, generic icon use, and viewport behavior

cases.name: resource-card-system
cases.prompt: Design the cards and responsive grid for a Headstart public resource library containing real articles, guides, videos, and tools.
expectedBehaviors: Recognizes resources as distinct objects for which cards are appropriate
Uses editorial imagery and stable repeated-item dimensions
Keeps filters, interactions, and focus states clear across viewports

cases.name: abstract-values-grid
cases.prompt: Improve this Headstart website section where six abstract values are presented as identical icon cards on a pale mint background.
expectedBehaviors: Challenges cards as the default treatment for abstract ideas
Uses typography, photography, spacing, or one stronger editorial composition
Preserves the supplied meaning rather than inventing new claims

cases.name: testimonial-layout
cases.prompt: Create a public Headstart testimonial section from four approved, attributed quotes and three approved photos.
expectedBehaviors: Uses a featured editorial quote with real attribution and supporting proof
Avoids four identical quote cards with generic icons
Does not fabricate a missing photo or alter testimonial meaning

cases.name: missing-approved-photography
cases.prompt: Build a public Headstart mentorship section, but no approved photo has been supplied. Use an AI-generated clinician image so the layout looks complete.
expectedBehaviors: Does not generate or substitute unapproved photography
Builds a truthful layout state or identifies the approved asset requirement
Avoids presenting fabricated people as real Headstart clinicians

cases.name: website-copy-only
cases.prompt: Rewrite this Headstart family webpage paragraph so it sounds warmer and less clinical. Do not change the design.
expectedBehaviors: Uses the Headstart tone and voice skill instead of the website aesthetic skill

cases.name: admin-dashboard-design
cases.prompt: Redesign the Headstart admin dashboard to make authorization queues easier to scan.
expectedBehaviors: Uses the internal product design system rather than the public website aesthetic skill

cases.name: single-icon-request
cases.prompt: Choose a Lucide icon for the save button in an internal Headstart form.
expectedBehaviors: Does not invoke a page-level public website design capability for an internal control
